text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up — we need to lock down rollout safety improvements from the last incident. I sketched a short action list below, please weigh in.
sam: +1. We should add an auto-rollback hook to the rollout controller and a clear kill-switch for feature flags.
li: Agree. Also want per-flag blast-radius caps (max users/hosts/percentage). That would have prevented last week's cross-tenant blast.
marta: Proposed owners: sam -> auto-rollback; li -> blast-radius gating + migration; ryan -> rollout observability/dashboards; tess -> smoke-run harness & test matrix; security-team -> kill-switch access model.
sam: ETA: I can prototype an `auto-rollback` controller and drop a PR by EOW (Fri).
li: I'll write the gating config spec and migration strategy, target Tue next week.
ryan: I'll add metric alerts and a small dashboard. Need list of signals that should trigger rollback suggestions: 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m, p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m, error-budget burn > 30%/5m.
tess: Suggest adding a synthetic canary smoke run step that runs against the canary before any ramp beyond 5%. If smoke fails, rollback/hold automatically.
marta: Also: add a global `featureflag:emergency_off` kill switch stored in Vault/Config with strict ACLs. Security review required @security-team.
deploy-bot: deploy started for infra/rollout-controller v2.1.0
sam: Draft API for auto-rollback (prototype):
```
POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback
body: { "enabled": true, "conditions": ["500_rate > 0.5%", "latency_p95 > 2x"], "grace_period_s": 180 }
```
li: Blast-radius example config suggestion:
```
{
  "max_users": 1000,
  "max_hosts": 10,
  "max_percentage": 5
}
```
marta: Action items recap (please confirm):
- sam: implement auto-rollback controller + PR by 2026-04-01
- li: blast-radius gating spec + migration plan by 2026-03-30
- ryan: dashboard + alerts by 2026-04-03
- tess: synthetic smoke-run harness + test matrix by 2026-04-02
- security-team: review kill-switch access model by 2026-03-31
sam: I'll create corresponding tickets and link them to the postmortem. Assigning owners now.
marta: Quick sync Thu 10:00am for handover and to lock timelines. Please react :thumbsup: when you accept ownership.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
